subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] mm/huge_memory: don't queue folios that can never be underused

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of anonymous PMD-sized folios in the Linux kernel by skipping the queuing of folios that can never be underused, reducing unnecessary work and improving performance. The default khugepaged/max_ptes_none setting causes the shrinker to never split these folios for being underused, so they are not queued. This change is particularly important for a subsequent patch that adds anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list, as it prevents small mTHP orders from taking the list_lru lock on every anonymous fault.
